M0.name: current-state-baseline
M0.rule: reject invalid endpoints; otherwise return CLEAN

MH.name: MS-plus-MT-diagnostic
MH.rule: union of MS and MT reason codes; diagnostic only

MS.name: strongest-fair-local-patchwork
MS.rule: M0 plus local state/scope/history rules only

MT.name: minimal-first-class-transition-candidate
reads: the exact same raw facts as MS
trigger, evidence, authority and approval fields
ordered path, hop and rollback fields
MT.rule: M0 plus explicit transition relation constraints; no new authority, truth, capability or lifecycle state
MT.transition_identity: deterministically derived from refs and tuple; not an external authority

task159_v2_signature.L1: NO when a semantic-conservative OldBasis -> NewRepresentation mapping preserves states, operations and questions
task159_v2_signature.L2: YES only for a previously unproducible object/operator class
task159_v2_signature.L3: YES only with a pre-leap unaskable to post-leap representable question
task159_v2_signature.L4: YES only for a failure mode passing all old checks
task159_v2_signature.L5: supportive only; requires two independent pre-existing families
task159_v2_signature.L6: YES only if removing the new semantic primitive loses capability
task159_v2_signature.challenger_priority: any complete challenger plus no independent L2/L3/L4/L6 increment is NON_LEAP
